title: ai_evaluation_checklist_enterprise_marketing
claim: Enterprise AI tools fail procurement audits because they lack traceable data lineage, forcing teams to manually recreate provenance for every generated campaign asset.
hook: Why your AI audit fails procurement.

evidence.detail: Observed across multiple enterprise procurement reviews where generative marketing assets were rejected for commercial use because teams could not verify training data sourcing or indemnity coverage.

reel_script.onscreen: Why your AI audit fails procurement.
reel_script.voiceover: Why your AI audit fails procurement. It is not because the copy is weak. It is because you cannot prove where the training data came from.
reel_script.direction: Static shot of a standard enterprise compliance review queue on a laptop screen.

visual.note: Typical procurement gate for enterprise marketing technology

reel_script.voiceover: Most marketing technology stacks treat generation as the end of the workflow. Enterprise compliance treats it as the starting question.
reel_script.direction: Close up on a compliance rejection notice highlighting missing attribution.

visual.note: The core misalignment in enterprise AI adoption

reel_script.voiceover: Before you deploy any generative tool across a regional marketing team, check your vendor contract for three specific clauses.
reel_script.direction: Medium shot of contract review highlights on screen.

items.label: Standard Clause
items.detail: Shifts all liability to the buyer

reel_script.voiceover: First, confirm that your enterprise prompts and brand data are explicitly excluded from training future public models.
reel_script.direction: Text overlay highlighting data privacy parameters.

items.label: Data Isolation
items.detail: Prompts remain private to your tenant

reel_script.voiceover: Second, verify that the vendor provides full intellectual property indemnity against copyright claims arising from generated output.
reel_script.direction: Close up on legal indemnity terms in software agreement.

reel_script.voiceover: Third, mandate an auditable prompt log so every campaign asset traces back to an exact seed and version.
reel_script.direction: Text overlay listing the operational checks required before sign-off.

visual.note: Required compliance checks for enterprise marketing tech

reel_script.voiceover: AI governance is a queueing problem, not a design problem. If your legal team has to manually verify every output, the technology has just created an expensive bottleneck.
reel_script.direction: Medium shot turning toward camera, addressing the viewer directly.

caption:
Why your AI audit fails procurement.

AI in enterprise marketing fails long before it hits the market because evaluation focuses on creative output while compliance evaluates legal exposure.

When a procurement committee reviews a marketing technology stack, they do not care how fast the model generates variants. They care who pays if a generated sentence infringes on existing industrial IP.

Send this to whoever is defending the AI software budget this quarter.
